chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Hadeed, from Mansour ibn Rawh, from Al-Sa'igh, who said:

I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: 'By Allah, you are a light in the darkness of the earth. By Allah, the inhabitants of the sky look at you in the darkness of the earth just as you look at the brilliant star in the sky. And indeed some of them say to others,

O so-and-so, it is astonishing for so-and-how he came to acquire this Matter (Al-Wilayah)', and these are the words of my father (peace be upon him): 'By Allah, it is not astonishing to see the one who is destroyed, how he came to be destroyed, but it is astonishing to see the one who was saved, how he came to be saved'.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Shia being described as a light in the darkness of the earth?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates the status of the Shia as a spiritual beacon ('light') amidst the world's darkness, drawing a celestial parallel to how inhabitants of the heavens gaze upon them with the same wonder humans reserve for a bright star. The Imam shifts the focus from the inevitable fate of the lost to the miraculous nature of the righteous's salvation, highlighting divine grace as the true object of astonishment. This narrative underscores the unique spiritual standing of the Shia community as witnesses and recipients of divine favor in the eschatological context.

en.hubeali: H 14863 – From him, from Ali Bin Hadeed, from Mansour Bin Rawh, from Al-Saaig who said:

‘I heard Abu Abdullahasws saying: ‘By Allahazwj! You (Shites) are a light in the darkness of the earth. By Allahazwj! The inhabitants of the sky are looking at you all in the darkness of the earth, just like you are looking towards the brilliant star in the sky. And that some of them are saying to the others, ‘O so and so, it is astonishing how he came to acquire this Matter (Al-Wilayah)’, and these are the words of myasws fatherasws: ‘By Allahazwj! It is not astonishing to see the one who is destroyed, how he came to be destroyed, but it is astonishing to see the one who was saved, how he came to be saved’.
